tariq: quick postmortem follow-up \u2014 we need owners, short timelines, and a lightweight tracker for GPU/autoscale remediation. proposing a 30m weekly sync.

maya: i'll own scheduler tuning. plan: perf baseline in 3 business days, conservative changes in 9 days, validate under synthetic 60-80% load by day 14. will coordinate with eng-infra.

anita: i'll take quota/vendor uplift. opening cloud/vendor tickets today; expect initial responses in 2-4 business days. will flag spend approvals if needed.

sam: i'll draft the surge/headroom runbook. first draft by day 7, tabletop at next sync. will include immediate mitigations and rollback steps.

opsbot: created task REM-4224 and recurring event "GPU Remediation Standup" (Fridays 10:00 PT). reminders set.

metrics-bot: snapshot: peak GPU util 98-99%, p99 queue latency spike. current free headroom ~6%. snapshot saved to s3://incidents/gpu/2087654321/snap.json
